title: task_sync_destination_occupied names the occupied candidate, the basis and the supported refresh steps
outcome: task_sync_destination_occupied names the occupied candidate, the basis and the supported refresh steps
acceptance: When export refuses because .engram already holds a different candidate, the refusal names the committed data HEAD, whether the occupied folder equals that commit's export, the observed export_basis, and the supported remedy (save the basis from the committed project.json, git rm the folder, re-export with the same selection, restore non-planning entries), or the one-command sync once it ships
A refusal test asserts those values and the remedy are present; no new refusal code or wire field is needed
